messages.name: bypass
messages.digest: Bypass the filter and output a dry signal
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a nonzero number will turn bypass mode on and cause the dry unfiltered signal to pass through to the object's outlet; followed by a 0 will output the filtered signal.

messages.name: clear
messages.digest: Reset all filter coefficients and sample memory
messages.description: Resets all coefficients and sample-memory to 0.

messages.name: dictionary
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that references a namedobject dictionary (set via theattribute), will cause theobject to use the dictionary values for filter coefficients.

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set the filter coefficients using sets of five biquad coefficients
messages.description: The filter coefficients can be provided as ain the left or right inlet. The coefficients should be in sets of five, each set corresponding to a second-order section or biquad. The first five coefficients in theare used for the first second-order section in the series, the next five for the second, and so on.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet: Signal to be filtered. The signal is filtered by a series of two-pole two-zero (i.e. biquad) filters, often referred to as "second order sections".

messages.name: zero
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a nonzero number will cause the filtered signal to be muted; followed by a 0 will output the filtered signal (this will not prevent the unfiltered signal from appearing at the outlet when bypass mode is turned on).
